title: The Part Library page has no create control (New Catalog Part removed)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Parts -> Part Library page on the build under test, with "Part Library & Inventory - Create & Edit".
custom_steps:
1. Read the Part Library toolbar and confirm there is no control that creates a library entry (the "New Catalog Part" button is gone).
  2. Confirm no create-a-library-entry dialog can be reached from the page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Part Library page has no control that creates a library entry - the "New Catalog Part" button is removed from its toolbar - and no create dialog is reachable from the page.
